moddbVisibility.title: Help other players find RiftLauncher
moddbVisibility.body: RiftLauncher is listed on ModDB, where a listing's download count is most of what decides whether anyone finds it. If you want to help, the launcher can ask ModDB once for that listing's archive, which registers as one download there. The archive is a 315 byte text file pointing at the releases page, not the launcher itself, and the launcher does not keep it. Nothing is installed and nothing else changes.
